critical_code_review_comments: OraiAssistantPanel now relies on inline style with `window.innerWidth` read at render time; the panel is opened via state so it recomputes on open, but a pure viewport resize while the panel stays open will not re-run the branch. Adding a resize listener (or using CSS media queries only) would make this fully resilient. Current retest closed/reopened the panel after each resize as required.
.or-surface { position: relative } global rule still exists in index.css and can still bite any future Tailwind .fixed usage that inherits or-surface — recommend refactoring to scope it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter_111 P0 (ORAi panel offscreen due to .or-surface relative override) and P1 (CourseMaker locked ReferenceError) are both fixed and verified at 4 viewports. No further action needed on these two items. Global .or-surface{position:relative} rule remains a latent risk — flag if similar breakage surfaces elsewhere.
rca_of_the_issue: Fixes applied by main agent: OraiAssistantPanel.jsx line 187–191 now sets inline style position:'fixed' plus explicit right/bottom (desktop) or left/right/bottom (mobile bottom sheet), which beats the class-level .or-surface{position:relative} because inline styles have higher specificity than any class rule. CourseMaker.jsx line 154 now declares `const locked = policy && policy.allowed === false;` matching the usages at lines 158 and 232+, resolving the ReferenceError.
